question: In Linear: Set the priority of the 3-point sub-issue of MOB-42 due on October 15 to High. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Nope — there isn't one. Here's what I found:

**MOB-42** ("Checkout crash on launch") has exactly one sub-issue:
- **MOB-57** — "Polish saved-card search" — **5 points**, due **Oct 22**, priority Low

The two 3-point issues due Oct 15 do exist, but they're not under MOB-42:
- **MOB-55** — "Fix Apple Pay sheet layout follow-up" → sub-issue of **MOB-421**
- **MOB-56** — "MOB-42 follow-up: Apple Pay sheet" → sub-issue of **MOB-7** (despite the name, it's not actually under MOB-42)

So I didn't change anything. If you meant one of those two (they share the Apple Pay theme with MOB-42's subtree), tell me which and I'll set it to High.
